title: FBI says AI hacking tool ARTEX can break into networks in under three hours
content:
The FBI has warned that hackers are using ARTEX, an AI hacking tool, against at least ten sectors. They range from banks and defence to healthcare and law. Some intrusions went from first targeting to privileged access in under three hours, the bureau said.
The warning came in a FLASH alert published on Friday, 13 November. It says the tool lets attackers with little skill run complex attacks on many targets at once.
ARTEX is an open-source framework in which AI agents carry out each stage of an attack with little human input. It has no AI model of its own. It plugs into models from Anthropic and OpenAI as well as Chinese-origin ones. DeepSeek’s Flash models are the most used on attackers’ servers, the FBI said. They are cheap and show no visible guardrails when attackers present a request as penetration testing.
The alert ties the tool to the theft of personal data on about 67,000 people from South Korean banks. It also ties it to the ConnectWise supply chain attack, which reached more than 2,250 downstream tenants.
Pulled from GitHub, still spreading
A developer called “Autumn-27” released ARTEX on GitHub in July. It gathered an estimated 1,500 to 2,000 stars within ten weeks. The developer said the tool was for authorised testing only. After reports of abuse, the repository came down on 8 October.
Forks, mirrors, archived copies and a paid version called ARTEX PRO keep it in circulation, the FBI said. Researchers counted more than 1,600 ARTEX consoles exposed online in early November. The real number of deployments is likely much higher, the bureau added.
What Amazon’s decoys caught
Amazon published its own findings on the same day. Its MadPot decoy sensors look like popular AI model services. Between 3 October and 5 November, they received requests from ARTEX agents that carried the agents’ own records of their campaigns. Amazon’s chief information security officer, CJ Moses, set this out in a company blog post.
In the largest campaign, agents stole API keys and other credentials for AI models. The stolen keys then paid for the AI that powered the hunt for more keys. Targets included AI gateways such as LiteLLM and app builders such as Dify and Ollama, The Register reported.
A second campaign tried to beat identity checks at two cryptocurrency exchanges with live deepfake video and forged ID photos. The verification vendor’s server rejected the deepfake every time, Moses wrote.
“The agents succeeded where basic security hygiene was missing, including default or hardcoded credentials, keys left in code and public artifacts, unauthenticated interfaces and inference endpoints, and unpatched software,” Moses wrote.
Barracuda changes every customer credential
Security company Barracuda has also disclosed an ARTEX-linked breach, TechCrunch reported. The tool found an exposed credential for a third-party service that Barracuda had not revoked when the work ended. That gave the attackers a way into stores of credentials Barracuda uses to collect data from its customers’ systems.
Its logs could not rule out access, so Barracuda changed all its customer credentials, according to TechCrunch. Its chief information security officer, Arve Kjoelen, wrote:
“Defenders who rely on spotting malicious activity and then responding to it will often arrive after the attacker has finished.”
Google also named ARTEX among several AI attack frameworks in its latest threat report on Monday. The FBI asked organisations to list every internet-facing system, including partner portals and employee apps. It also urged them to keep admin interfaces off the open internet.

report.summary: FBI警告AI黑客工具ARTEX可将入侵时间压缩至3小时
report.background: 随着大模型能力增强，攻击者开始用AI智能体串联侦察、提权、横向移动等攻击环节。ARTEX于2025年7月由一个网名Autumn-27的开发者开源发布，十周内获得约1500-2000星；虽在10月因滥用被下架，但分支、镜像与付费版ARTEX PRO仍在流传，11月初已有超1600个控制台暴露在公网。这类框架本身不含模型，而是调用Anthropic、OpenAI及DeepSeek等外部API，把低成本模型变成可批量复制的攻击流水线。
key_points: FBI在11月13日的FLASH警报中称，ARTEX已针对银行、国防、医疗、法律等至少十个行业发起入侵，部分案例从首次侦察到拿到特权账户不到三小时。
ARTEX是开源AI智能体框架，本身不含模型，而是接入Anthropic、OpenAI和中国来源的模型；FBI称DeepSeek的Flash系列因便宜、且把请求包装成渗透测试时看不到明显防护，最受攻击者青睐。
该工具被认为与韩国银行约6.7万人个人数据泄露、以及波及2250多家下游租户的ConnectWise供应链攻击有关。
亚马逊的MadPot诱捕系统在10月至11月捕获到ARTEX智能体的攻击流量，其中最大一次行动是窃取AI模型API密钥，再用盗来的密钥支付继续扫描的成本。
Barracuda因第三方服务凭据未及时吊销而遭入侵，最终被迫更换全部客户凭据；谷歌也在最新威胁报告中点名ARTEX。
report.impact: 对AI行业而言，模型厂商的滥用防护与API计费体系成为新的攻击面，'渗透测试'话术成为绕过安全策略的通用钥匙；对开发者，默认口令、硬编码密钥、未鉴权的推理端点等基础卫生问题正被智能体以极高速度放大，谁暴露在公网谁先中招；对普通用户，银行、医疗等机构的供应链风险直接转化为个人数据泄露，且防守方发现时攻击往往已经结束。
report.tools: 想跟进可研究亚马逊MadPot这类AI诱捕与威胁情报方案，加固LiteLLM等AI网关的鉴权与密钥轮换，检查Dify、Ollama的默认配置与公网暴露面，并为模型API设置额度与异常调用告警；同时可关注谷歌威胁报告中列出的AI攻击框架清单用于自查。
